themes.name: Shaft & Shadow
themes.description: Tadao Ando's concrete chapel distilled into type — a single blade of golden light cutting through heavy graphite structure, restraint as its own ornament.

props.text: One blade of gold. The rest is concrete. Restraint is the only ornament worth keeping.

themes.name: Graphite Solstice
themes.description: Swiss grid precision meets sacred geometry — raw concrete surfaces fractured by a single shaft of golden morning light.

props.text: Concrete remembers the sun. A single gold fracture splits Swiss order — precision holding its breath against morning light.

themes.name: Neon Compendium
themes.description: A rain-slick information rail where deep indigo structure meets hot-pink neon precision — the quiet discipline of a Tokyo transit directory viewed through wet glass at dawn.

themes.name: Amber Emulsion
themes.description: A dawn gallery bathed in harvest warmth — rich leather tones and forest shadows frame vivid imagery like specimens behind archival glass.

props.text: Dawn breaks through archival glass — harvest leather and forest shadow hold vivid specimens in amber suspension.

themes.name: Concrete Breviary
themes.description: Tadao Ando's restraint translated into type — raw warm gray, a single shaft of amber light, and the quiet weight of well-set serif text at dawn.

props.text: Ando's silence made typographic. One amber shaft. The rest is warm gray and patience.

themes.name: Light Shard
themes.description: Tadao Ando's Church of the Light distilled into graphic type — raw concrete weight split by a single golden blade, restrained to the point of severity.

props.text: Where concrete meets gospel light — one cut, no apology. The golden blade does not decorate. It divides.

themes.name: Terrazzo Matins
themes.description: Memphis geometry meets Ando's dawn light — bold geometric type fractures a pale concrete ground while soft gold accents bloom like early morning shafts through raw aggregate.

props.text: Concrete remembers the night. Gold remembers the sun. Terrazzo holds both — fractured, patient, luminous at dawn.
Memphis geometry fractures a pale concrete ground.
